longterm_view.reasoning: Operating cash flows show positive generation over three periods [CASH, operating_cash_flow], but critical fundamentals such as balance sheet health, three-year financial rows, and EPS are entirely missing from the provided data. Furthermore, business extracts highlight heavy reliance on customer concentration without long-term supply agreements [business, page 219].
